negative_proof: Retention of the full new-coordinate cube would induce a peeling of its reduction C to 0. C has unique initial corner 0 and more than one word, so this is impossible.
general_formula: For k>=1, order = 292*2^k-3, dimension = 12+k. All proper cube faces can be retained; the full cube cannot. All proper nonempty-target pc-minors can retain the target.
scope: Positive relative-minimal cube-boundary examples, not ordinary forbidden classes. The k=2 case demonstrates that all boundary roots and edges can be attainable while full square retention fails.
